title: Hearty British Onion Wrap
description: A charred and crumbly British dish featuring caramelized onions, wrapped in a corn husk wrap, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, caramelize the onions over medium heat for 20 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, make a mother sauce by whisking together the flour and butter, then slowly adding the vegetable broth.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until melted and smooth.
To assemble the wraps, lay a corn husk flat and spoon some of the onion mixture onto the center of the husk.
Drizzle the mother sauce over the onions and season with salt and pepper.
Fold the sides of the husk over the filling and roll up the wrap to enclose.
Place the wraps on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes, or until the husks are lightly charred.
